QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Know Thyself! (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: You went to borrow blue ink and found a donkey named Stew...
QuestInfo.1: Cole asks you to borrow Blue Ink from Stew in his place. And what's up with quiz all of sudden?
QuestInfo.2: Now that you solved the quiz and received an ink, return to Cole.

0.2: If you need some Blue Ink, I'd be happy to provide it. BUT, I want to see how smart you are about your own party! It's quiz time!!
